text_block_list.text: I'm still an amateur, aren't I? I can't believe I got hurt. Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I've inconvenienced you as well, Trainer.
For that,
I'm very sorry.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list: I think it would be best to rest today.

You should pay more attention to your
surroundings from now on.

text_block_list.text:
What?! Th-that's taking it too far! Just a
little
medical attention would be
enough!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Aren't cuts and bruises a
regular
occurrence in training? If
something this small
worries you, you'll
never get the chance to relax,
you
know?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Then... I don't know what to say.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Your concern has been thoroughly conveyed.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
If you insist, then I shall devote myself
fully to
rest and recovery for the day.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You're right... I mustn't be so focused
that I
ignore my surroundings.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
However, the thought that I made such
an
elementary blunder is...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I feel guilty all over again...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You're right... I mustn't be so focused
that I
ignore my surroundings. Having
said that...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
One might say that my focus proves I
was training
efficiently.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It would surely come in handy sometime
if I
manage to better hone this ability to
concentrate.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Now, shall we return to our training
before my
focus is broken?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
After treating Мэдзиро МакКуин's injury, I
see her
back to the dorm.
